verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs describe a centralized rule system to define and enforce engineering standards, rules mined from PR history, and governance that enforces consistent standards across repositories automatically. However, the evidence never shows how rules are authored (natural language, AST patterns, or linked style guides) or how the reviewer applies them to findings. Missing for 10: documented natural-language rule authoring, AST/pattern-based rules, linking external style guides, detail on how custom rules surface as review findings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I encode my team's own review guidelines — natural-language rules, AST patterns, or linked style guides — and the reviewer enforces them
